title: flowintel contains an authorization flaw in its recurring reminder notification subsystem. (CVE-2026-133850)
description: flowintel versions prior to 4.1.0 have an authorization flaw in the recurring reminder notification subsystem. Users who previously had access to private cases but later lost access can still receive and view recurring reminder notifications related to those cases. This flaw allows unauthorized information disclosure of case titles, reminder messages, and metadata. There is no impact on data integrity or availability.
